title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Billing Calendar: Next-Period Rent within a Tow Redemption
content:
**Rule.** A redemption of a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement under a notice of intent to tow also collects toward the next billing period, by the distance to the next rent due date. The next rent due date is the day after the last day of the most recently charged billing period. Counting calendar days from the handling date to that date:

- where it is no more than 7 days away (a date already reached included), the redemption also collects the next period's contracted monthly rent in full;
- where it is more than 7 but no more than 14 days away, it collects half (0.5) of that rent;
- where it is further away, it collects nothing toward the next period.

The rent collected is added to the redemption amount, and the total is rounded to the cent. The rent is the agreement's contracted monthly rent.

### Hypothetical calendar (most recent period 21 July to 20 August; next due date 21 August; contracted rent $240.00)

| Handling date | Days to 21 August | Collected |
|---|---|---|
| 14 August | 7 | $240.00 |
| 13 August | 8 | $120.00 |
| 7 August | 14 | $120.00 |
| 6 August | 15 | nothing |
